about: The proposed run schedule for the-ultimate-insider team. Each run is one scheduled task that starts a fresh conductor session on this repository; the conductor runs each step as a sub-agent that reads its state, does one kind of work, writes its state and stops. A draft: no scheduled task exists until the operator approves this file. Kept by conductor@the-ultimate-insider.
timezone: Europe/London (assumed; to be confirmed by the operator)
lock: admin/runs/LOCK: written when a run opens, removed when it closes. A run that finds a lock says so first and does not start a second one.
ledger: admin/runs/index.jsonl: one row per run, with each step's outcome

steps.do: open: hold check, uncommitted changes, leak check over the tree
sweep for new public agent incidents; capture and hash the next sources in the claims register
next slides or notes from the outline; update the time budget
build, gate, release; check the live site shows the new version
close: leak check over the run's diff
digest: what each step did, what is blocked and on whom, the asks for the operator
fold in the operator's answers from the day; next slides or notes
re-check every captured source still says what the claim needs; flag drift
run-through: minutes per act against the forty, slides without a source, acts without a figure
the week: what shipped, what the talk still lacks, the roster and schedule changes to propose

not_scheduled.why: Second wave: wired once there is a deck to review.
